text:
anya: Midweek plan — casual watch party tonight for the match? small foosball tourney in the break room + fantasy trade window open. wifi upgrade landing at 7pm though :soccer:  
kevin: 100% in. what time? also can we make the foosball bracket single elimination, 8pm start? :thumbsup: 
maria: I'll bring snacks (chips + salsa). can someone add a tiny sign-up so we don't double up? :popcorn: 
luis: I'm down. @kevin you still want my WR for your RB? i can `propose trade` in the league if yes. 
kevin: @luis yep i will take that. propose when you get a sec, i'll accept if my bench looks ok. also need to charge my laptop — anyone bring a usb-c hub? 
anya: got one, i'll leave it by the whiteboard. FYI wifi upgrade might disrupt streaming for ~5 mins around 7pm per ops. deploy-bot: NOTICE: Scheduled wifi maintenance will apply to office-guest network from 19:00 to 19:10. No action needed for wired connections. 
maria: Ack. we can shift the stream to a local mirror if it drops. i'll stash the stream link: https://twitch.tv/localmatch in the calendar event. 
kevin: Perfect. foosball bracket posted here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/foobar — sign up column B.  
luis: Trade proposed: `luis -> kevin: WR_Mendez for RB_Sharp`  
kevin: accepted. confirmed. :party_parrot: 
anya: Awesome. See you all at 7:45 for warmups. low-key, come hang, no pressure. 
maria: who wants the last mini-sampler of guac? i call dibs if someone saves a bowl :pleading_face: 
kevin: i'll save one. 
anya: putting a sticky on the fridge. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
